# Test error handling for invalid inputs
# Verifies that the generator handles error cases gracefully

env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

# Test: Invalid framework name
! exec generate-framework-bindings -framework NonExistentFramework12345 -input $INPUT_DIR -output output2
stderr '(?i)not found|failed|error'

# Test: Missing output directory creates it automatically
mkdir test_output
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output test_output/generated
exists test_output/generated/coregraphics/functions.gen.go

# Test: Output directory with existing files (should overwrite)
mkdir existing_output
exec sh -c 'echo "old content" > existing_output/functions.gen.go'
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output existing_output
grep 'Code generated from Apple documentation' existing_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
! grep 'old content' existing_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
